figures.subject: THE FED VESSEL

source.title: Of the Fed Vessel
source.deck: Dormancy has a body, a reserve, and a return condition.
source.fiction: The jar was sealed against the winter. Every seventh day someone warmed the room in which it stood. The account recorded that the jar had required nothing.
source.caption: A conceptual reserve vessel with three leaks and a separate restart threshold. Internal reserves and external shelter are different supports. The curves below are illustrative quantities with arbitrary units, generated from declared equations rather than measured organisms.

pages.title: Where the cost went
paragraphs: [E] Boussard and colleagues reported habituation to salt in Physarum polycephalum that remained detectable after one month in a dormant sclerotial stage. Sodium acquired during training was retained through that stage [B1]. This is a specific experimental result about a treatment and a response. It does not establish indefinite memory, memory of every kind, or institutional survival through repression.

[D] A stored capacity depends on some material arrangement continuing to hold. The arrangement may rely on internal reserves, environmental conditions, active caretaking, or a combination. Calling the focal object inactive does not tell us whether its supporting conditions are free, stable, or inside the boundary of the account.

[H] A recurring institutional error may be to count only the active organization while treating its refuge as scenery. A library's storage, a member's spare room, a volunteer's time, or a host institution's electricity may carry the supposedly dormant capacity. This is a proposed accounting diagnosis. Whether it explains a failure has to be checked against actual resource use and responsibility.

[V] The supporting person is not a reserve that an institution owns. Naming unpaid care makes it visible to negotiation; it does not convert care into an unlimited obligation. The vessel cannot establish an entitlement to the keeper's life.

pages.title: A maintenance interval is a claim
paragraphs: [D] Consider an explicitly artificial reserve R(t). Between renewals it decreases at a constant rate c; a renewal adds q, up to a capacity limit. Continuation requires R(t) to remain above a specified threshold. This toy model can show how an unchanged renewal schedule fails when c increases. It has no authority to estimate c for a real person, group, or organism.

[D] Restart can demand more than preservation. A device may retain a record with little power yet require a large current to start. A group may retain an address list yet lack meeting space or time for shared work. The plate therefore draws a storage threshold and a higher, task-specific restart threshold. Their order is an illustration, not a law: some restarts may instead cost less than ongoing preservation.

[H] The useful test is a witnessed resumption, limited enough to be affordable and real enough to expose missing dependencies. Record what the trial drew on, including work supplied by people outside the focal boundary. A failed rehearsal may reveal a capacity that existed only on paper. Rehearsal itself can consume scarce reserves, so its frequency also needs justification.
[F] The jar's defect is in the account. The seventh-day fire has been omitted. Correcting the ledger will not keep the room warm. It may establish who must answer when the warming stops.

NEW SUBJECT — THE FED VESSEL — Clavicula Intervallorum, Chapter III. A single SEALED RESERVE JAR as a figure-device, no human body or keeper. Rounded cream glass-like vessel in a delicate cellular-lattice protective cradle, a tightly closed lid and a quiet material reserve shown inside as a small dormant folded reticulum near the base, not a face or creature. Three fine BLACK seep paths descend from three small points along the jar's lower body to terminal dots, expressing distinct leaks. A separate thin BLACK restart collar sits above a lower black storage band; no scale, numbers or explanatory curves. A narrow external support loop embraces the lower cradle, separate from the internal reserve. ONE RED FEEDING THREAD enters that external support from outside the vessel boundary and visibly keeps the support connected: flat #a32b24, RGB163,43,36, single fine path with a small terminal dot. No red lid, wax or additional seal. This is a reference object derived from the manuscript's sealed winter jar, material reserve, external care and three leaks; no claims of scientific measurement. Sparse slate in a few lattice cells and tiny ochre near the support collar. Square PNG 1:1, target 2048 x 2048 if possible, whole jar plus support and feeding thread occupy central 75 percent of square. No room, fire, text, figures or frame.
